title: Registry build
description: Builds an Ndop registry with ndop build (ADR-0012): validates items, checks imports, type-checks with ngc, checks version snapshots and writes the static registry.

registryRoot.description: Folder holding registry.json, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the project root.

outputPath.description: Folder the static registry is written to (files land under its r/ subfolder), relative to the workspace root.

tsconfig.description: tsconfig the compile check extends, relative to the workspace root, so packages mapped in its paths resolve.

frozenSnapshots.description: Fail when an item version has no committed snapshot. Defaults to true when the CI environment variable is set.

metadata.description: Extract component metadata into r/metadata and fail on incomplete docs (ADR-0007).

compat.description: Also write r/compat/<name>.json, items the shadcn CLI installs (ADR-0025).

registry.description: Ndop's registry, which @ndop/<name> registryDependencies are fetched from: a URL template, or a path template relative to the workspace root, containing {name}. Defaults to NDOP_REGISTRY, then https://ndop.dev/r/{name}.json.

compatBaseUrl.description: Absolute URL r/compat/ is served from, which compat items' registryDependencies point under. Defaults to https://ndop.dev/r/compat/.
